name: EGA pond _openAPond unbounded buyback percentage
summary: The EGA deposit pond's payable _openAPond(uint256,uint256) swaps percent/100 of its BNB into EGA with amountOutMin 1 and never caps the caller's percent. After a flash-loan buy of EGA, the attacker called it with 1 wei and a percent of 100 times the pond's balance, so the pond spent all its BNB at the inflated price; the attacker then sold back.
notes: Unverified, non-upgradeable runtime whose EGA token and router addresses are constructor constants, so deployment sets the age; the 0x9305a1fe percentage path is read from bytecode and the trace.
Among all calls into the pond (Etherscan normal and internal transaction lists), only this transaction swapped more BNB than its msg.value, so it is the first and only exploit.
Loss is the pond's native BNB balance drop; the attacker's smaller profit reflects swap fees and EGA's transfer tax.
